title: Whole Three Bryophytes and U-Shaped Comparison Bench Scene
description: One newly authored static whole-bryophyte teaching comparison arrangement, one scene and zero new independent models. Three complete accepted originals retain their own illustrative dimensions: the entire forked notched liverwort and all gemma cups lie on the front-left wing, the whole lobed hornwort and all five complete capsule assemblies occupy the front-right wing, and the entire leafy moss with every leaf, rhizoid, seta, capsule and tooth stands on a low rear-left step. A new broad continuous U-shaped scene-only bench has two grounded front wings, an open central front notch, and one low rear step, not the old elevated branching three-pad rack or a replacement pair on its original flat slab. Every original GLB binary payload, normal/index stream, complete material dictionary and internal node hierarchy is preserved; only whole-instance translations are added, with no resizing, trimming, recolouring or repeated model counts. The models depict different representative external forms and different artistic enlargement factors, not measured relative biological sizes, a common colony, a complete life cycle, a phylogenetic ladder or universal morphology of their groups. The bench is an artificial classroom juxtaposition, not a habitat, soil system or natural growth surface. No new independent botanical asset is claimed. No labels, textures, working instrument, stability/load certification, cultivation, physiology, rig, animation or interaction.
